                    ### Question
                    All of the following side effects are produced by Cisplatin except

                    opa. Ototoxicity

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Cisplatin is known to cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity due to its effects on inner ear hair cells and renal tubular cells, respectively. It is also associated with a coasting effect where neurotoxic effects continue post-treatment. However, pulmonary fibrosis is not a recognized side effect of Cisplatin, as evidence linking it directly to lung tissue damage is broad and not specifically supportive of this condition.
